name: hausa_natural_noise_development_protocol_v1
primary_metric: Co-Teaching ensemble clean-development accuracy versus naive accuracy
analysis: Three family-wise one-sided paired contrasts, Holm-corrected together; macro-F1 is a secondary imbalance audit
development_gate: Freeze and run the clean test split only if every family has nonnegative mean accuracy gain and at least one family has Holm-adjusted p < 0.05; otherwise retain this as development-only evidence.
claim_boundary: The observed weak-label error rate is supplied to Co-Teaching as an oracle forget rate; clean labels are used only for post-selection audit and clean development evaluation.
test_policy: The 582-example clean test split remains unused until the development gate is evaluated.
